item.title: Open Source Daily — Tuesday, October 27, 2026
item.description: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 KV-cache leak / SGLang 0.5.22 fix; Ollama 0.40.12-rc0 MLX DFlash2; MLX-LM Flint + MLX-VLM MiniMax M3.1 Flash (no 64GB fit); Linux 7.4 Apple M4 support; Pharo 14.
